theme: Filling every slot in a very wide instruction
title: Bundle Packing Against the Register File
strategies: one-op-per-cycle DAG-order construction, no bundle packing (trivial)
max-fill list scheduling: pack every bundle slot with any ready op (greedy)
register-pressure-aware list scheduling: admit new producers only within a live-value budget narrower than the register file, leaving slots deliberately empty (strong)
jointly optimal schedule+register-allocation search (NP-hard in general, open ceiling)
